_note: Search-matched hero copy (homepage + general ad landers with personalize: true). First match wins; no match keeps the page's own H1. Claims must stay word-for-word with what the site and ads already say ('fair cash offer in 24 hours', as-is, no repairs, no agent commission). H1s write as-is with a non-breaking hyphen (\u2011) so it never wraps as 'as- / is'. Matched against utm_term, keyword and utm_campaign. ?fsho_intent=<id> forces a bucket for demos.
city_line: Selling a house in {city}? Ask for a no-obligation cash offer.

buckets.label: Foreclosure / behind on payments
buckets.h1: Behind on payments? See your options while there's still time.
buckets.sub: Get a fair cash offer in 24 hours and see if a sale fits your timeline. Sell as-is with no repairs, no agent commission, and we cover closing costs. We are not your lender or attorneys.

buckets.label: Probate / inherited
buckets.h1: Selling an inherited or estate house? Sell it as‑is.
buckets.sub: Get a fair cash offer in 24 hours, without clearing out or fixing up the house first. No agent commission, we cover closing costs, and we do not give legal advice.

buckets.label: Divorce / separation
buckets.h1: Selling the house in a divorce? One clear offer you can both review.
buckets.sub: Get a fair cash offer in 24 hours. A private, as-is sale with no string of showings, no agent commission, and we cover closing costs. We do not take sides, and we are not attorneys.

buckets.label: Landlord / tenants
buckets.h1: Done being a landlord? Sell the rental as‑is.
buckets.sub: Get a fair cash offer in 24 hours, even with tenants in place. No repairs, no agent commission, and we cover closing costs. We do not promise an eviction or that tenants will leave.

buckets.label: Repairs / as-is
buckets.h1: House needs work? Sell it as‑is.
buckets.sub: Get a fair cash offer in 24 hours. No repairs, no cleaning, no agent commission, and we cover closing costs.

buckets.label: Relocation / sell fast
buckets.h1: Need to sell fast? Sell on your timeline.
buckets.sub: Get a fair cash offer in 24 hours and pick the closing date that works for you. Sell as-is with no agent commission, and we cover closing costs.
